scope.savedConfigBytesContract: Saved config JSON NEVER contains the literal `"model"` key when the operator omits --model / UMACTUALLY_MODEL. Saved config JSON DOES contain the literal when --model <id> is supplied.
scope.showConfigContract: `umactually --show-config` always emits a `model:` line. When saved model is absent the value is the literal `auto (resolved at review time)`. The TUI's `umactually tui → View Config` flow mirrors the same placeholder line.
scope.initEnvDefaultsContract: Init env defaults consult ONLY the five kept UMACTUALLY_* env vars (UMACTUALLY_API_URL, UMACTUALLY_API_KEY, UMACTUALLY_MODEL, UMACTUALLY_PROVIDER, UMACTUALLY_GITHUB_API_BASE). All other env vars have no influence on the wizard's persisted saved config. UMACTUALLY_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS / REVIEW_PROMPT_BYTE_CAP / REVIEW_FILE_LIMIT / REVIEW_* legacy env bindings (already removed by tasks 1ca1c2c + 27e9591) are not consumed by the wizard.

behaviorChanges.initDryRun: runDryRunInit no longer fabricates model='auto' when --model is omitted. The plan JSON shows the saved-config shape (provider + apiUrl when non-default + no model).
behaviorChanges.initNonInteractive: runNonInteractiveInit no longer fabricates model='auto' for any provider branch (openai-compatible, anthropic, copilot). The saved-config bytes carry no `"model"` key when --model / UMACTUALLY_MODEL are unset.
behaviorChanges.initInteractive: buildPerBranchPrompts no longer offers a default of `auto` for the model prompt; the placeholder text reads `(resolved at review time)` and an empty answer falls through to `undefined` (no `"auto"` written).
behaviorChanges.initHelpText: INIT_HELP_TEXT replaces `--model <id>               Provider model id (default: auto)` with `--model <id>               Provider model id (optional; resolved at review time)`.
behaviorChanges.dispatchShowConfig: renderShowConfig always emits the `model:` line. When saved.model is undefined the value is `auto (resolved at review time)`. The dispatcher's firstPositionalToken gate is unaffected.
behaviorChanges.tuiConfigFlow: renderSavedConfig mirrors dispatch.renderShowConfig — the `model:` line is always present; absent saved.model renders as `auto (resolved at review time)`.
behaviorChanges.tuiReviewFlow: The TUI's Model text prompt's `initialValue` falls back to `""` instead of `"auto"`. The wizard still collects whatever the operator types; empty answer becomes `parsed.model === ""` which `validateSavedConfig` (saved-config.ts:253) coerces to `undefined` so the persisted file never carries `"auto"`.
behaviorChanges.standaloneRunArtifact: The no-diff and empty-diff artifact `modelId` placeholders use `(auto)` instead of the literal `auto` so a downstream JSON parser can distinguish the placeholder from a real model id. The live-outcome path (line 178) still uses `outcome.modelId` (already a resolved id from the provider's model discovery or explicit --model flag).
behaviorChanges.orchestratorSkipFallback: The 'PR changes N files, exceeds --review-file-limit' skip path's modelId placeholder uses `(auto)` instead of `auto` for the same reason.
behaviorChanges.helpText: help.ts `--model <id>` flag description in both the review and global flag tables reads `(optional; resolved at review time)` instead of `(default: auto)`.
